tools.name: kb_get_document_type
tools.title: Get the document type
tools.description: Get a file's document type and proposed name and folder from saved entries, conventions and the complete listing. Return saved classification or candidate document types. Appends the answer to `log.jsonl` and opens no knowledge-base file.

location.description: A knowledge-base or document location as plain text. knowledge-mcp logs this text and never opens the location.
location.title: Location

folders.description: Folder names from the knowledge-base root down to the folder whose universe specs apply, such as `["docs", "rfcs"]`. Empty for the root folder.
folders.title: Folders

knowledge_bus_folders.description: Every folder containing .knowledge-bus/, including peer folders. Include empty configuration folders. Classification uses the ancestors of the subject document; filing compares peers under the applicable universe specs.
knowledge_bus_folders.title: Knowledge Bus Folders

role.description: The reader's role, such as maintainer. Put document types for that role first.
role.title: Role

record.description: The unedited text of `.knowledge-bus/plugins/knowledge-mcp/document-types.yaml` under the knowledge base root folder. When that file is missing, send the text of `.knowledge-bus/plugins/knowledge-mcp/record.yaml`, which knowledge-mcp 0.2.1 and earlier used. Send an empty string when both files are missing.
record.title: Record

record_digest.description: Send the document-types digest from an earlier result in this session in place of `record` while the file remains unchanged.

changes.description: Files changed since the document-types file was last saved. Send them with `record` or `record_digest`. knowledge-mcp applies the changes to the entries for this answer only.
changes.title: Changes

conventions.description: Current target conventions file text. Send empty text when the file is absent.
conventions.title: Conventions

conventions_digest.description: Conventions digest received in this session. Reuse while the file remains unchanged.
conventions_digest.title: Conventions Digest

folder.description: The declaring folder relative to the knowledge-base root; empty for the root.

text.description: Complete conventions text, or an empty string to report an absent file.
text.title: Text

digest.description: A digest from this session, in place of unchanged conventions text.

files.description: Every `*.kbp.yaml` file directly inside the `.knowledge-bus/` folder.
